capabilities: Route notes into folders by rules
Build dynamic destination folders from placeholders
extras: Full rule, criteria, and filter references live on external documentation pages; on-edit and periodic automation triggers are off by default. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer.
motivation: Most Obsidian users hit the same wall: notes pile up in the inbox, and manually dragging them to the right folder every time is tedious and easy to skip.
problem: Notes pile up in the inbox and manually dragging each one to the right folder is tedious and easy to skip.
summary: Rule-based note mover that routes notes into folders using tags, properties, filenames, dates, and links, automatically or on demand.
